filename: GCM-Filters_ A Python Package for Diffusion-based Spatial Filtering of Gridded Data.pdf
title: GCM-Filters: A Python Package for Diffusion-based Spatial Filtering of Gridded Data
testbed_rationale: This paper presents GCM-Filters, an open-source Python software library for spatial filtering on curvilinear grids; no ML dataset or benchmark dataset is provided.
pain_points: GCM data comes on irregular curvilinear grids with spatially varying grid-cell geometry
Continental boundaries require careful and special treatment when filtering ocean GCM output
Earth Science applications benefit from configurable filters, where filter scale and shape are flexible
GCM output is often too large to process in memory, requiring distributed or delayed execution via Dask
extraction_notes: JOSS software paper introducing GCM-Filters (version 0.2.3). While spatial filtering is critical for coarse-graining training data for subgrid parameterizations, no ML training is conducted here.
